cut.name: obj_tenna_enemy event_user(2) ladder (Other_12) — including the TRIPLE FEATURE

It is orphaned: obj_tenna_enemy only ever calls event_user(0) (Step_0:50) and nothing in ch3 does `with (obj_tenna_enemy) event_user(2)`. It also writes `_minigamecount`, which is a var LOCAL to Other_10 (declared at Other_10:1) — proof it was split off from the live chooser. Consequently `minigametype3` / `difficulty3`, plumbed all the way through obj_tenna_enemy_Create_0.gml:39-40, Step_0:1230-1231, obj_tenna_zoom_Create_0.gml:32-33 and the con == 3 chain at obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:769-798, can never be reached: the live chooser sets _minigamecount to 1 or 2 only (Other_10:1, :51).

cut.name: Other_10 phaseturn == 18 / == 19 ultimate re-entry blocks
cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_tenna_enemy_Other_10.gml:60-67 and :69-76 are byte-for-byte duplicates that re-select battle difficulty 3. Neither runs in the live fight: phaseturn = 18 is assigned by gml_Object_obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:435 MID-TURN, and the same block immediately sets minigametype/difficulty and calls event_user(1), so LIGHT 'EM UP starts without the chooser. That turn then never ends — obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:14-15 floors global.turntimer at 4 on every step, and the zoom's only exits to con = 2 (Step_0:448-468, :561-571) have no arm for minigamedifficulty == 3 — so event_user(0) is never reached again and phaseturn stays 18 (which is exactly what gml_Object_obj_tenna_minigame_ui_Draw_0.gml:1 tests for). These blocks are belt-and-braces; the only other writer of phaseturn 18 is the dead `testlightemup` flag at Other_10:19-20 (written false once, at Create_0:121).

mechanics: WIN CONDITION IS POINTS, NOT HP. Tenna has 5500 HP / AT 13 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_monstersetup.gml:1861-1866) but the fight ends when obj_tenna_enemy_bg.myscore >= 1000 AND haveusedultimate == true (gml_Object_obj_tenna_enemy_Step_0.gml:37-42 -> endcon = 1). Encounter 121 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_encountersetup.gml:867-881) is SOLO: monstertype[1] and [2] are 0. THREE KINDS OF TURN. (a) Ordinary bullet turns, myattackchoice 0/1/2, red soul in the standard box created at Step_0:555-562. (b) PHYSICAL CHALLENGE turns, myattackchoice 3, which set minigametransition_con = 1 (Step_0:600-608), fly obj_actor_tenna into the screen and create obj_tenna_zoom (Step_0:1183-1243) — a SECOND dispatcher keyed on a STRING minigametype plus an int difficulty (obj_tenna_zoom_Other_11.gml). (c) The LIGHT 'EM UP finale. Minigame turns run at turntimer 999 with a hard floor of 4 (obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:14-15) and end by forcing global.turntimer to 1 (Step_0:1258-1261). Failing a minigame does no damage during it: obj_tenna_zoom counts minigamefailcount (capped at 3, Step_0:1295-1296) and the boss cashes it in afterwards at Step_0:1298-1375 for 56 / 26 / 18 damage per fail (doubled onto Ralsei alone if POPULAR BOY is active). HOW A MINIGAME TURN IS TRIGGERED: the player ACTing 'Minigame' (Step_0:839-872 — acting 2/3/4/5 fall into 5.1, which sets minigameactivated), OR Tenna's HP dropping to 50% (Other_10:34-39, which then forces choice 3 every turn and bumps minigamecount TWICE per turn because :41-45 also fires), OR minigameinsanity (:54-58). DOUBLE FEATURE: once minigamecount >= 6 the chooser sets _minigamecount = 2 (Other_10:47-52) and queues two minigames in one turn via minigametype2; obj_tenna_zoom chains them at con == 3 (Step_0:769-798). MINIGAME ORDER is a global.tempflag[91] ladder (Other_10:78-292, tempflag[91] written nowhere else in the chapter): 1 cooking, 2 music, 3 battle d1, 4 cowboy d0, 5 music, (6 skips to 7), 7 susiezilla d2 or battle d2, 8 cowboy d1, 9 music, 10 cowboy d0, (11 skips to 12), 12 battle d2, 13 music, 14 cooking, 15 susiezilla d3 or battle d1, 16 cowboy d1, then a weighted random pool with a 3-pass anti-repeat filter. FINAL PHASE (MINIGAME INSANITY): HP <= 20% or score >= 1000 sets minigameinsanity (Other_10:9-10); the chooser forces music as that turn's opener (:287-291), then obj_tenna_zoom channel-surfs between minigames on a shrinking timer (120 -> 50 by -10, then -1 down to a floor of 30, Step_0:299-311), the pool narrows to choose(1, 2, 4, 5) once the timer is <= 60 (:339-340), and on the 5th flip at 30 it forces battle d3 = LIGHT 'EM UP (:423-436). SOUL MODES: red soul for 125 / 126 / 128 and battle d2 only; sharpshoot and LIGHT 'EM UP replace the soul with an aiming cursor and reposition/re-sprite all three heroes into zoo suits (obj_lightemup_controller_Create_0.gml:22-57); cowboy uses obj_shootout_heart; music, cooking and susiezilla replace player control entirely. LIGHT 'EM UP's BULLETS DO NOT COME FROM THE CONTROLLER: obj_actor_tenna's Draw event runs the pattern generator, gated on `i_ex(obj_lightemup_controller) && obj_shadowman_sharpshoot_target.type == 4` (gml_Object_obj_actor_tenna_Draw_0.gml:1063-1510), and it is what prints 'DEFEAT TENNA!' and sets obj_tenna_enemy.stopshoot. SIDE SYSTEMS the boss Step also runs: the score meter (obj_tenna_enemy_bg, addscore / myscore / maxscore 1000, banked through gml_GlobalScript_scr_tenna_add_score.gml — which routes points to obj_tenna_minigame_ui.myscore instead while obj_tenna_zoom exists), the turn-count point multiplier (Step_0:52-59), Susie's BET act (Step_0:959-993, 20 points, 30 with the Jevil tail), Ralsei's POPULAR BOY act (Step_0:1046-1096), the Lancer stool cheat (Step_0:757-785), and a 22-step balloon-dialogue state machine (Step_0:71-545) with a sword-route branch on global.flag[1050] (Create_0:73-74).
engineNeeds: THE THREE ORDINARY BULLET ATTACKS SHOULD RUN. 125 / 126 / 128 are conventional obj_dbulletcontroller work; obj_tenna_allstars_manager, obj_tenna_allstars_bullet, obj_tenna_smashcut_attack, obj_tenna_smashcut_manager, obj_tenna_rimshot_star and obj_lensflare_manager are all present in docs/js/gml_objects.js, as are obj_lightemup_controller, obj_lightemup_bg, obj_shadowman_sharpshoot_target, obj_tenna_lightemup_bullet, obj_tenna_zoom, obj_tenna_enemy_bg, obj_tenna_minigame_ui, obj_actor_tenna, obj_shootout_controller, obj_rhythmgame, obj_susiezilla_gamecontroller, obj_chefs_init, obj_elnina_umbrella and obj_umbrella_tv. Caveat: obj_tenna_allstars_manager uses ds_list plus two surfaces and a GML 2.3 `spawn_new = function(arg0)` method, and opens with snd_loop(snd_crowd_laughter_loop) (Create_0:1-15). ITEMS THE STUDIO STILL NEEDS. (1) REGISTER THE BOSS: docs/gml_studio.html's MONSTER_TYPE map (:1572-1578) needs `obj_tenna_enemy: 103` and its BOSSES list needs an entry, or the fight gets no stats and no boss instance. obj_tenna_enemy's own Create builds the rest of the cast for free (obj_actor_tenna preset 2 at Create_0:80-81, obj_tenna_enemy_bg at :88-89, obj_tenna_minigame_ui at :91) but it also calls scr_enable_screen_border(1), scr_enemy_object_init(), scr_speaker("tenna") and destroys obj_battleback, and it hard-requires obj_herosusie + obj_heroralsei (Step_0:1-10 exits without them). (2) THE MINIGAME TURN IS NOT AN ANNOUNCED ATTACK. The myattackchoice == 3 branch (Step_0:600-608) sets no global.monsterattackname and creates no controller, so gen_attacks.js's announcement scan yields NOTHING for the 10 real PHYSICAL CHALLENGE variants. They need a declared launch mode the way Pink's dates do (`launch: 'tenna-minigame'` carrying minigametype + difficulty) that creates obj_tenna_zoom directly with those two fields set, skipping the obj_actor_tenna jump-in. (3) TYPE-150 DEDUP COLLISION. Three dispatches produce obj_dbulletcontroller.type = 150 — Step_0:609-615 (cut choice 20), obj_tenna_zoom_Other_11.gml:251-267 (sharpshoot) and :358-377 (LIGHT 'EM UP). gen_attacks.js's dedup key is boss|controller|type|pattern|datecount, so all three collapse into ONE entry and the CUT choice-20 one wins (the enemy's own event files are scanned before extraAttackFiles). By luck that entry still plays the real finale — obj_lightemup_controller_Create_0.gml:4-8 downgrades the target to type 5 only when myattackchoice == 21 or obj_tenna_zoom.minigamedifficulty == 1, and choice 20 satisfies neither — but the sharpshoot variant is unreachable from the dropdown unless an obj_tenna_zoom is faked with minigamedifficulty = 1. Note also that the two Other_11 entries arrive with selector null, so the studio's bossDispatched gate (gml_studio.html:1684-1685) would give them no box block, no turn block and no setup even if they survived dedup. (4) LIGHT 'EM UP NEEDS obj_actor_tenna ALIVE AND DRAWING. Its bullets are spawned from gml_Object_obj_actor_tenna_Draw_0.gml:1410-1506, a 1877-line Draw event; the studio's `also` list sets e.step = null but leaves draw intact, which is what this attack needs. obj_lightemup_controller's Create also references obj_tenna_enemy, obj_herokris, obj_herosusie and obj_heroralsei UNGUARDED and calls scr_act_charsprite on all three, so a full three-hero party is required.
